ai_summary: Affle Holdings Pte. Ltd., a promoter of Affle 3i Limited, has increased its stake by converting warrants into 2,981,479 equity shares, raising its voting capital percentage from 40.63% to 42.74% and its total diluted holding to 43.58%. While this conversion provides capital to the company and signifies increased promoter commitment, a material red flag is the existing encumbrance of 57,215,465 shares (approximately 40.60% of the company's capital) within the promoter's overall holding, which could pose risks related to financial leverage.
